r)\,d^3r=2,\quad E_x^{\rm HF}=-E_H/2\ \text{one-orbital restricted Hartree--Fock He only} Hは無限質量点核の1電子、Heは球対称1軌道の閉殻HFまたは交換のみLDAです。 text.en: NUMERICAL METHODS ATLAS · PROBLEM Helium ground state: closed-shell HF and exchange-only LDA Explore this problem’s equations, reference conditions, methods and published code. Saved result figure Computed from the public atomic-code fixed inputs, with conditions, CSV profiles, convergence checks and independent references linked in the reading. Equations and problem definitions Representative equations related to this problem. See the image/problem conditions and each execution example for initial conditions, boundary conditions and parameters. Closed-shell Hartree–Fock equations F^=h^+∑j∈occ(2J^j−K^j),F^ϕi=εiϕi FC=SCε,C†SC=I Closed-shell occupied-orbital RHF equations include nonlocal exchange. Preserve existing He local-reduction and H2RHF examples. New calculations cover only fixed minimal two-electron H2/H3+ models; UHF equations have their own mapped model. No general multicenter molecules, global open-shell stability, complete-basis or general correlated-method guarantee. Local Kohn–Sham DFT E[n]=Ts[n]+∫vextn dr+EH[n]+Exc[n]+ENN [−12∇2+vext+vH+vxc]ϕi=εiϕi n(r)=∑ifi∣ϕi(r)∣2,∫n dr=N,vxc=δExcδn Representative local Kohn–Sham equations. Published examples cover spin-unpolarized exchange-only Dirac LDA for spherical helium and LDA exchange plus VWN5 correlation for fixed periodic He/He₂ cells. The radial atomic implementation and periodic PySCF workflows are separate series with different bases, boundaries and references. Inspect each input and validation record below; these examples do not validate GGA, hybrids, general materials or excited states. Stationary electronic Schrödinger equation H^elΨ=EelΨ,Etot=Eel+∑A<BZAZBRAB Fixed-nuclei nonrelativistic electronic eigenproblems; add nuclear repulsion separately. Preserve the existing hydrogenic radial examples. Additional examples are restricted to one-dimensional box/HO and two-electron FCI in at most3AOs, not general many-electron direct solvers or continuum-exact molecules. Formulations used by execution examples Common execution exampleApproximation or discretization Helium: closed-shell HF and exchange-only LDA [h^r+12vH[n]]u=εu(He 1s2 RHF) [h^r+vH[n]+vxLDA(n)]u=εu,vxLDA=−(3nπ)1/3 h^r=−12d2dr2−2r,n(r)=2∣u(r)∣24πr2 Atomic-unit radial equations restricted to isolated spherical closed-shell 1s² helium. The RHF vH/2 form is specific to two electrons sharing one spatial orbital. LDA is exchange-only, without correlation; no UHF, GGA, hybrid, general molecular or periodic-DFT example.
